combat.name: Chain Reaction
combat.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs a maximum of 3 attacks that deal <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front after a short casting time.
Mitya will instead perform the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Detonation</color>, which consumes no Stamina, if a <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core: Overload{/LINK}</color> created by Mitya himself is currently on the field and he has at least 1 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color>: Deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front and continuously consumes <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacons</color> while held. Each <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> consumed deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> upon impact.

combat.name: Principle: Variable Detection
combat.descriptionRaw: Conducts a theoretically relatively safe experiment at a theoretically relatively safe yield, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and creating a <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> in different ways depending on whether the Skill is tapped or held.\n\nTapping the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> again within 6s after using it changes the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color>'s state. The Detection Core's state can be changed in this way every 1.5s.

combat.name: Analysis: Gradient Theory
combat.descriptionRaw: Let the elements burst forth like inspiration itself! Deals <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and creates 3 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color>.

passive.name: Baseline Stress Test
passive.descriptionRaw: The <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> created by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> is enhanced. Depending on the state of the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> created:\n·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 30 Elemental Mastery for each <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color> Mitya has;\n·Overloaded: After nearby party members trigger Stellar-Conduct reactions, instead obtain 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> every 1.5s for 6s.

passive.name: Explosive Reagent: Safe Limits Exceeded
passive.descriptionRaw: The duration of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> is increased to 10s. Additionally, Mitya's CRIT Rate increases by 5% for 15s after creating a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color>. This effect can stack up to 4 times.
passive.description: The duration of Gradient Beacons is increased to 10s. Additionally, Mitya's CRIT Rate increases by 5% for 15s after creating a Gradient Beacon. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

passive.name: Stellar Jubilee: Top-Secret Protocol
passive.descriptionRaw: When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct. Stellar-Conduct reactions will no longer create <color=#FFD780FF>Starlight Prisms</color>, and will instead create 1 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color> nearby every 1.5s for 3s. These Beacons can be carried by Mitya and transform the area around them into an even larger <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>. Triggering another Stellar-Conduct reaction will refresh the duration of the aforementioned effects.\nAdditionally, the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by all nearby party members will be increased based on Mitya's Elemental Mastery: Every point of Elemental Mastery he has increases Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.028%. The maximum Base DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%. While within a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>, Mitya will also enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state.
passive.description:

passive.name: Energy Catalysis
passive.descriptionRaw: When destructible rocks are nearby, <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core: Steady State{/LINK}</color> can quickly clear them.\nAdditionally, when Mitya is in the party, creating <color=#FFD780FF>Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source</color> does not consume Kresnik Energy.
passive.description:
When destructible rocks are nearby, Detection Core: Steady State can quickly clear them.
Additionally, when Mitya is in the party, creating Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source does not consume Kresnik Energy.

levels.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing
levels.descriptionRaw: The maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> additionally creates 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color>.\nWhile the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.\nAdditionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.
levels.description:
The maximum number of Gradient Beacons Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection additionally creates 1 Gradient Beacon.
While the Detection Core is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.
Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a Gradient Beacon is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

levels.name: The Matter That Slumbers Beyond Inertness
levels.descriptionRaw:
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, all opponents within the <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color> have their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> decreased by 20%.
Additionally, if the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> created is:
·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery;
·Overloaded: Your own active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.

 · Is in the Steady State: <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> deals 115% of its original DMG.
